neighbours.label: Dense pole; strongest on the Devanagari letter श (sha) and, more weakly, sh-letters of other scripts (Arabic ش, Cyrillic ш)
fire: The Hindi word for power is shakti (शक्ति), a term also used for the goddess.
In Hindi a lion is called sher (शेर), and the word appears in many place names.
Travellers soon learn that the Hindi for city is shahar (शहर).
A dictionary entry in Hindi begins with the shabd (शब्द), meaning word.
Schools in Delhi use the term shiksha (शिक्षा) for education.
The Hindi name for Saturday is Shanivar (शनिवार), after the planet Saturn.
Friends often meet in the shaam (शाम), which is Hindi for evening.
Yoga teachers speak of the sharir (शरीर), the Hindi word for the body.
quiet: The Hindi word for salt is namak (नमक), a term also used in many idioms.
In Hindi a lotus is called kamal (कमल), and the word appears in many personal names.
Travellers soon learn that the Hindi for house is ghar (घर).
A recipe in Hindi often begins with the phal (फल), meaning fruit.
Schools in Delhi use the term kitab (किताब) for a book.
The Hindi name for Monday is Somvar (सोमवार), after the moon.
Friends often meet at raat (रात), which is Hindi for night.
Farmers watch the baadal (बादल), the Hindi word for clouds.
